chunks.title: Besan_Bhindi_fry_chatpati_____Navaratri_special__
chunks.text: Hello guys, welcome back to my channel Indian Kitchen. Today I am going to show you how to make Bhindi Fry. First of all, we have washed the okra and dried it. Now we will cut it. Cutting it long is the best way to make it. First, we will remove this part. Now we will cut it. Now we will cut it from the middle. Now we will cut it. Cut it long as per your choice. It will be more crispy. Now we will cut it. You can cut it as per your choice. We have cut all the okra. Now we will add the spices. The main thing is to add 1 tbsp carom seeds. It gives the main flavor. It is good for digestion. Now we will add chili as per taste. You can add it as per your taste. Add 1 tsp turmeric powder. Add 1 tsp coriander powder. Add 1 tsp garam masala. Add 1 tsp cumin seeds. I have roasted the cumin seeds. Add 1 tsp black salt. We have added black salt. So we will add less white salt. Add 1 tsp chaat masala. Add 1 tsp white salt. We have already added salt and chaat masala. I have crushed some garlic. Add it without water. It is optional. If you don't eat it, then don't add it. Add 1 tsp oil. Now we will add gram flour. Add 3 tbsp gram flour. Add 1 tsp corn flour. If you want to add rice flour, it will give extra crunch. You can add that too. Now we will leave it for a while. Mix it. Cover it for 15 minutes. After 10 minutes, the okra is ready to fry. Heat oil in a pan. We will fry the okra in this. We are using mustard oil. Add okra to the pan. Fry it. We will fry it on medium flame. So that it is crispy. If we fry it on high flame, it won't be crispy. So we will fry it on medium flame. We will not flip it for 1-2 minutes. We will fry all the okra in 2-3 batches. After 1-2 minutes, we will flip it. It has been 4-5 minutes. The color is changing. Now we will take it out. We will fry it on low flame. It is ready. You can see the crunch. If you haven't subscribed to my channel yet, please subscribe. Okra fry is ready. If you like our recipe, please like and subscribe. It is so crunchy. Thanks.
